digest.component_or_area: terraform-drift CI workflow and Gerrit pre-submit gating
propositions: terraform-drift.yml only triggers on pull_request, push to main, or schedule, but Gerrit changes flow through a mirror and do not fire these triggers, so drift checks do not run pre-submit

a terraform change can receive Verified +1 and be submitted without proof that its HCL resources have been applied to the live infrastructure, creating a gap between code landing and infrastructure state
unapplied terraform resources are only discovered post-merge when the push-to-main trigger fires and fails, at which point main is already red and the change has already been submitted
the manual apply step is folklore rather than enforced process, so reviewers cannot distinguish between a terraform change that is complete and one awaiting manual infrastructure deployment

the drift check must either run as a pre-submit gate (distinguishing the change's own not-yet-applied additions from previously committed unapplied HCL) or require explicit apply attestation in the landing workflow to close the gap
